description:
An Instagram profile's Reels tab (up to 50 reels) with views, likes, comments, cover image and approximate publish time, plus profile basics.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: id (string), username (string), full_name (string), is_verified (boolean), profile_pic_url (string, nullable), follower_count (integer, nullable), reels (array<object>), reels_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of reels to return. Example: 12

username.description: Instagram username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "nasa"

name: instagram_reels
title: Instagram reels
